title: Mixture of Experts from Scratch
blurb: Route tokens to experts, combine their outputs, budget total versus active parameters, and keep the load balanced with capacity, auxiliary losses and bias updates.
intro: A mixture-of-experts layer replaces one large MLP with many smaller ones and a router that sends each token to a few of them. The steps cover top-k routing with renormalised gates, dispatch and combine, the total versus active parameter count that makes MoE attractive, expert capacity and dropped tokens, the balance and z-losses, and auxiliary-loss-free balancing with a selection bias. The capstone implements a whole layer with all three balancing mechanisms and reports how many assignments were dropped.
